# Kiwi Mono

Kiwi Mono renders the editor in a true monospaced font, keeping character-width spacing consistent and equalizing font sizes for plain-text editing. A single accent color drives auto-generated shades, sidebars and tabs are flattened to match the editor, heading margins are tightened, and blockquotes and callouts are harmonized. Reading mode is left font-agnostic.

![Kiwi Mono screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/c-sooyoung/kiwi-mono-obsidian-theme/HEAD/thumbnail.png)
